author: Jersey City NJ Daily Brief
title: 💻 Jersey City IT Roundup: Multiple High-Paying Tech Roles
text:
1 days ago Jersey City’s tech scene is buzzing right now—especially around cloud, cybersecurity, AI, and fintech. If you’ve got solid engineering or analysis skills, there’s a lot here worth a weekend of applications.
Generative AI Engineer Employer: Apex Systems
Location: Jersey City, NJ (Onsite)
Type: Contract
Salary: Not listed
Build GenAI apps with LLMs, RAG, and multi-agent workflows, integrating with Oracle, Starburst, S3, and OpenShift. Ideal if you’re a senior Python/LLM engineer who likes platform-level work and CI/CD.
Senior Apache Spark Developer Employer: Apex Systems
Location: Jersey City, NJ (Onsite)
Type: Contract
Salary: Not listed
Lead big data processing on Spark and Kafka while helping move workloads to Databricks and AWS . Great fit if you’re strong in Spark SQL, streaming, Java, and Python and like large-scale, high-volume data.
Blockchain Developer Employer: Enterprise Solutions Inc.
Location: Jersey City, NJ (Onsite, local, F2F interview)
Type: Full-time
Salary: Range not disclosed ("actual compensation" based on skills/experience)
Hands-on blockchain build role: network design, consensus, smart contracts, dApps, and security. Requires strong Java and interest in both core blockchain and app-layer development.
Associate Director Automation Test Engineering (Blockchain) Employer: DTCC
Location: Jersey City, NJ (Hybrid: 3 days onsite)
Type: Full-time
Salary: Range not specified (role includes base pay + annual incentive)
Lead end-to-end automation testing for DTCC’s blockchain/tokenization platform using Java , APIs, and smart contract testing. Great for senior SDETs who want web2 + web3 exposure with AI-assisted testing.
Business Systems Analyst – Cloud Product Enablement Employer: DTCC
Location: Jersey City, NJ (Hybrid)
Type: Full-time
Salary: Range not specified
Bridge business and cloud engineering for AWS/Azure enablement , documenting requirements, operating models, and security patterns. Perfect for a BA who knows cloud concepts and likes enterprise-scale work.
CICS/MQ Systems Programmer Employer: Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH)
Location: Jersey City, NJ
Type: Full-time
Salary: $135,000 – $175,000 base + annual target bonus
Own MQSeries and CICS on z/OS across production and test, including installs, upgrades, performance tuning, and on-call support. Great fit if you’re a seasoned mainframe engineer who enjoys deep infrastructure.
Senior Web Engineer Employer: Caesars Entertainment (Caesars Digital)
Location: Jersey City, NJ
Type: Full-time
Salary: $160,000 – $180,000 + potential bonuses, 401(k) match, medical, dental, vision, FTO
Lead high-scale web apps using React, TypeScript, micro-frontends, and mobile runtimes (Capacitor/Cordova) for Caesars’ digital gaming products. Great for senior frontend devs who enjoy performance and UX.
Associate Product Manager (APM) Employer: DTCC
Location: Jersey City, NJ (Hybrid)
Type: Full-time
Salary: Range not specified
Early-career but senior-leaning product role supporting AI tools, internal platforms, and pilots . You’ll own defined product slices, manage backlogs, write requirements, and partner closely with engineers.
Cybersecurity Saviynt L3 (Contract) Employer: Raas Infotek
Location: Jersey City, NJ (Day-1 Onsite)
Type: Contract
Salary: Rate negotiable
Senior Saviynt IAM support/architecture role: handle complex incidents, connectors, workflows, and RCA. Requires 8+ years Saviynt/IAM and strong troubleshooting; USC/GC only .
Business Analyst with RBAC Employer: Themesoft Inc.
Location: Jersey City, NJ
Type: Contract
Salary: Not listed
Partner with product, engineering, and risk teams to define a new entitlements/RBAC framework for a reporting platform. Great if you’re a BA comfortable with IAM, role engineering, and detailed mapping docs.
Cloud Development Engineering Principal (AWS/Terraform) Employer: DTCC
Location: Jersey City, NJ (Hybrid)
Type: Full-time
Salary: Range not specified
Lead enterprise AWS + Terraform platform engineering: reusable modules, landing zones, guardrails, and CI/CD integration. Ideal for senior cloud engineers who enjoy infrastructure as code at scale.
Cyber Red Team Operator (Senior) Employer: Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH)
Location: Jersey City, NJ
Type: Full-time
Salary: $120,000 – $160,000 base + annual target bonus
Run advanced red team, adversary emulation, and purple team work across cloud, identity, apps, and infra. Great match for an experienced offensive security pro with scripting skills and MITRE ATT&CK depth.
Cyber Security Engineering Associate Director – AI Gateway Employer: DTCC
Location: Jersey City, NJ (Hybrid)
Type: Full-time
Salary: Range not specified
Own the Kong-based AI Gateway for LLMs, agents, and RAG: architecture, IAM, policy-as-code, resiliency, and observability. Perfect if you sit at the intersection of cloud security, APIs, and AI platforms .
Application Programmer (Java, Real-Time Systems) Employer: Mitchell Martin Inc.
Location: Jersey City, NJ (Hybrid)
Type: Contract
Compensation: $68.26–$73.26 per hour
Contract Java engineer role focused on high-performance, real-time distributed systems , modernizing legacy apps and supporting trading-style workloads in the cloud.
Program Analyst – Commercial Insurance Tech Employer: SageSure
Location: Jersey City, NJ (Hybrid)
Type: Full-time
Salary: Not listed
Business/tech hybrid role supporting commercial P&C insurance platforms : gather requirements, map processes, support QA, and improve workflows. Good for early-career BAs with insurance experience.
Cybersecurity Saviynt L3 Employer: AppLab Systems, Inc
Location: Jersey City, NJ (Onsite)
Type: Full-time
Salary: Not listed
Similar senior Saviynt IAM role, but as a direct full-time hire: heavy on complex troubleshooting, connector management, automation, and mentoring L2 teams.
GenAI Customer Engineer Employer: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)
Location: Jersey City, NJ
Type: Full-time
Salary: $80,000 – $100,000 per year
Client-facing GenAI solution architect role: design architectures, guide use-case delivery, and produce implementation docs on top of cloud and GenAI platforms.
Associate Director, Lead Software Developer Employer: RBC Capital Markets LLC
Location: Jersey City, NJ (Hybrid)
Type: Full-time
Salary: $193,461 per year + discretionary bonus & benefits
Lead full-stack dev for fixed income and equity trade processing platforms, manage offshore teams, own architecture, and drive SDLC best practices in a capital markets environment.
Epic OpTime Senior Consultant Employer: Deloitte
Location: Jersey City, NJ (supports Pacific hours; some travel)
Type: Full-time (project-delivery model)
Salary: $91,100 – $179,500 + potential annual incentive
Configure and optimize Epic OpTime (surgery/OR workflows), from scheduling to anesthesia records, for healthcare clients. Great for certified OpTime builders wanting less travel than classic consulting.
